metadata.task_description: Implement F-007 Sentiment Propagation, F-008 Capital Flow Divergence, F-009 Cross-Event Correlation

architecture_patterns: PropagationGraph DAG with cycle detection (Tarjan) and topological sort (Kahn)
PropagationLifecycle 4-state machine: DETECTED -> PROPAGATING -> SETTLED / EXPIRED
ImpactAnalyzer with 4 metrics: direct, cascaded, aggregate, risk-adjusted

coding_conventions.error_handling: ValueError for invalid transitions, TypeError for registry type checks
coding_conventions.async_patterns: No async used in event module (synchronous only)
coding_conventions.serialization: to_dict()/from_dict() round-trip pattern on all schemas
coding_conventions.testing: pytest with class-based test grouping, helper functions for factory patterns

source_code.rationale: 6 existing detectors define the pattern for new detector types. Each implements detect(data)->Optional[Event], event_type()->str, confidence_score(data)->float. All use _event_id() helper for UUID generation and _extract_date(data) for date extraction.

PropagationGraph has apply_decay_to_edges(days) already implemented with idempotent double-decay prevention. Uses _original_weight attribute on edges. Missing: integration with PropagationLifecycle state transitions for automatic decay triggering.
ABC with 3 abstract methods: detect(), event_type() (classmethod), confidence_score(). New detectors must implement all three.
Maps event_type string -> detector class. Methods: register(), unregister(), get_detector(), list_detectors(), detect_all(). New detector types need registration.

EventContract has settled_at field but NO settlement_status enum, NO settlement_metadata, NO settlement_result. Only has affected_theses/positions, impact_scores, aggregate_impact, propagation_depth. Needs settlement lifecycle enhancement.
Event v3.0 has 10 EventType values. New detector types need new EventType enum entries. PropagationState has 4 states: DETECTED, PROPAGATING, SETTLED, EXPIRED.
ImpactAnalyzer computes impact = severity * confidence * decay_factor * path_weight. Uses compute_decay() from lifecycle module. Already integrates decay into impact scoring.

4-state machine with VALID_TRANSITIONS. CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES maps 6 event types to half-life values. compute_decay() and apply_category_decay() provide exponential decay. Missing: automatic decay trigger on state transitions.
EVENT_TYPES defines 6 types. New detector types need new entries. SOURCE_PRIORITY defines 8 sources. EVENT_CATEGORY_MAP groups types into 4 categories.
SHA-256 based dedup. Merge strategy: highest confidence wins. New detector types must work with existing dedup logic.
Bidirectional event-review linkage. 30-day configurable window for revision detection. Referential integrity validation.
Thesis has event_influences (list[str]) and event_influence_weight (float) for event references. Integration point for EventContract settlement.
Decision has event_trigger_id and event_influence_score. AttentionOrigin.EVENT_ATTENTION indicates event-driven decisions.
Review has event_id and event_trigger_type ('direct'|'propagated'|'manual'). Post-event review linkage.
Schema-layer PropagationEdge (distinct from graph.py internal PropagationEdge). Has weight, decay_rate, edge_type, src/tgt_entity_type.
F-007: edge_type=sentiment for sentiment propagation. F-009: correlation edges (bidirectional). F-008: divergence events create edges. apply_decay_to_edges already supports per-type decay.
F-008: divergence events use settle(). F-007: cascade metrics in settlement_metadata. F-009: correlation results stored as EventCorrelation objects.

tests.rationale: Tests for BaseDetector ABC, DetectorRegistry, Taxonomy, 6 concrete detectors, and DeduplicationEngine. Uses stub detector classes (_EarningsDetector, _PolicyDetector, _SentimentDetector). Pattern: class-based test grouping with helper functions.
Tests for DAG structure, cycle detection, topological sort, BFS traversal, depth limit, determinism, lifecycle transitions, decay model, category decay, stuck protection. 18 tests total.
Tests for direct/cascaded/aggregate/risk-adjusted impact, decay accuracy, edge cases (expired event, zero-weight), ImpactReport serialization, performance (1000-node < 150ms).
Tests for schema extensions, bidirectional linking, revision detection, referential integrity, multiple events same thesis, decision event tracking.
End-to-end pipeline: data -> detect -> dedup -> graph -> impact. Uses tmp_path for file isolation. Tests full workflow.

critical.rationale: Pattern for new detectors: each class extends BaseDetector with event_type() classmethod returning string, detect(data)->Optional[Event], confidence_score(data)->float. Uses _event_id() and _extract_date() helpers.
key_patterns: class FooDetector(BaseDetector): event_type() -> str; detect(data) -> Optional[Event]; confidence_score(data) -> float

critical.rationale: apply_decay_to_edges(days) exists with idempotent guard (_original_weight). Missing: automatic decay trigger on PropagationState transitions. Missing: per-edge decay rate vs global decay.
key_patterns: edge._original_weight stored on first call for idempotency
returns dict[str, float] mapping edge_key -> decayed_weight

critical.rationale: EventContract has settled_at but NO settlement_status, NO settlement_result, NO settlement_metadata. Only stores affected entities and impact scores. Needs settlement lifecycle fields.
EventType enum has 10 values. New detector types need new enum entries. PropagationState has 4 states.

class PropagationState(str, Enum): DETECTED, PROPAGATING, SETTLED, EXPIRED
Event v3.0 fields: severity, confidence, decay_rate, source, propagation_state, propagation_graph_id, contract_id

key_patterns: CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES: earnings=6.5, policy=1.5, sentiment=2.0, theme=4.0, capital_flow=2.0, corporate_action=5.0

key_patterns: EVENT_TYPES: dict[str, str] mapping type -> description
EVENT_CATEGORY_MAP: dict[str, list[str]] grouping types by category
SOURCE_PRIORITY: dict[str, int] for dedup resolution

key_patterns: __getattr__ for lazy imports to avoid circular dependencies

high.rationale: Thesis.event_influences and event_influence_weight are the integration points for EventContract settlement.
Decision.event_trigger_id and event_influence_score link decisions to events.
Review.event_id and event_trigger_type link reviews to events.

medium.rationale: ImpactAnalyzer already uses decay_factor in scoring. New decay features need integration here.
EventReviewIntegrator handles bidirectional linking. New settlement features may need integration.
Schema-layer PropagationEdge has weight and decay_rate. Graph-internal edge is distinct.
DeduplicationEngine.merge_events() preserves v3.0 fields. New event types work with existing logic.
key_patterns: resolve_conflicts: groups by event_type + title + event_date

low.rationale: BaseSchema provides id, schema_version, status, created_at, updated_at, source_type, created_by, market_context.

user_intent.goal: Implement 3 new feature specs: F-007 Sentiment Viral Propagation (R0, cascade detection), F-008 Capital Flow Divergence (institutional/retail scoring), F-009 Cross-Event Correlation (event clusters, type affinity matrix)
user_intent.scope: New schemas (SentimentPropagation, CapitalFlowDivergence, EventCorrelation), new algorithms, integration with existing PropagationGraph and EventContract, comprehensive tests
key_constraints: Build on existing event module (8 EventTypes, 8 detectors, PropagationGraph, EventContract settlement)
All changes additive — no breaking changes to existing APIs
Lazy Upcast for new schema fields
F-009 depends on F-007 and F-008

breaking_changes: EventType enum needs new entries (additive, non-breaking)
EventContract needs new fields (additive, non-breaking via Lazy Upcast)

conflict_detection.mitigation_strategy: All F-007/008/009 changes are purely additive: new schemas, new methods, new edge types. No existing APIs modified. Lazy Upcast ensures backward compatibility.

new_detector_types.description: New detector types need: (1) EventType enum entry, (2) detector class extending BaseDetector, (3) taxonomy entries, (4) CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES entry, (5) tests
new_detector_types.existing_pattern: 6 detectors in detectors.py follow identical pattern

propagation_graph_decay.description: Graph decay exists (apply_decay_to_edges) but missing: (1) automatic trigger on lifecycle transitions, (2) per-event-type decay rate from CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES, (3) decay threshold for edge pruning

event_contract_settlement.description: EventContract has settled_at but missing: (1) settlement_status enum (pending/settled/expired/disputed), (2) settlement_result (what happened), (3) settlement_metadata (additional context), (4) lifecycle integration
event_contract_settlement.existing_pattern: EventContract with basic fields, LifecycleState enum for state tracking

sentiment_propagation.description: F-007: Viral coefficient (R0) via BFS, cascade detection (R0>1.0 AND depth>=2), SentimentPropagation schema, integration with PropagationGraph edge_type=sentiment

capital_flow_divergence.description: F-008: Divergence score = (inst-retail)/(|inst|+|retail|+eps), classification (bullish>0.3, bearish<-0.3, neutral), CapitalFlowDivergence schema, EventContract settlement integration

cross_event_correlation.description: F-009: Correlation via EVENT_TYPE_AFFINITY matrix + temporal proximity, combined impact (amplification/dampening), EventCorrelation schema, correlation edges on PropagationGraph
cross_event_correlation.existing_pattern: PropagationGraph, EventContract, all existing event types

critical_files.rationale: 6 existing detectors define pattern for new ones. All implement BaseDetector ABC.
PropagationGraph with decay support. Needs auto-decay trigger and threshold pruning.
EventContract schema needs settlement lifecycle fields.
EventType enum needs new entries for new detector types.
CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES needs new entries. VALID_TRANSITIONS may need settlement transitions.
EVENT_TYPES and EVENT_CATEGORY_MAP need new entries for new detector types.

patterns.description: Each detector: class FooDetector(BaseDetector) with event_type() classmethod returning string, detect(data)->Optional[Event] checking trigger conditions, confidence_score(data)->float computing confidence from 0.0-1.0

All schemas: dataclass with to_dict() method calling super().to_dict() then updating with schema-specific fields. from_dict() classmethod using base_from_dict() for BaseSchema fields then constructing with data.get() defaults.
compute_decay(impact_0, decay_rate, days) = impact_0 * e^(-decay_rate * days). apply_category_decay(event_type, impact_0, days) uses CATEGORY_HALF_LIVES to derive decay_rate = ln(2)/half_life.
Tests use _make_event() factory functions, _build_*_graph() graph builders, class-based test grouping (TestFoo), and pytest.approx for float comparisons.
Integration tests use tmp_path fixture, YAML file creation, full pipeline execution (detect -> dedup -> graph -> impact), and assertion on end-to-end results.
